_doc: Carrier tier = weighted fleet (widebody x2, narrowbody x1, regional jet/turboprop x0.5), per brand. Cargo operators are excluded from the passenger tier and get cargo_tier from the same formula with regional feeders at x0.25. Group tier = sum of its non-cargo brands against the group thresholds. Contract (capacity purchase) regional carriers cannot rank better than capacity_purchase_best_tier. Airport tier = annual passengers in millions; tier 1-2 airports are hubs. A value at the minimum belongs to that tier (>=200 is tier 1).
